label: Contract
source: Indian Contract Act, 1872 and common contract practice. Verify against the law that applies to your document.

rules.title: Balanced termination
rules.benchmark: Both sides should be able to end the contract on similar terms and notice.
rules.flag: Only one side being able to end the contract is unusual.

rules.title: Changes need consent
rules.benchmark: Terms should change only with both sides' written agreement.
rules.flag: One side changing terms at its sole discretion is unusual.

rules.title: Capped liability
rules.benchmark: Liability is normally limited to a reasonable amount, often the contract value.
rules.flag: Unlimited liability or indemnity is unusual.

rules.title: No silent auto-renewal
rules.benchmark: Renewals should need notice and a clear way to opt out.
rules.flag: Automatic renewal without notice is unusual.

rules.title: All charges disclosed
rules.benchmark: Every charge should be stated in the contract.
rules.flag: Open-ended or undisclosed charges are unusual.

rules.title: No restraint of trade
rules.benchmark: Agreements that stop someone carrying on a lawful trade are void under Section 27 of the Indian Contract Act.
rules.flag: A restraint of trade is against the law.
